reviewNotes:
Version 1.3 (build 26) supports eight app and quote languages: English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish and French. The app UI and generated PDF quotes use the language selected in Settings, including exports from older projects and saved quote versions. Seven PDF quote styles are available; choose the default style and paper size in Settings > Quote Settings. Pro removes SteelFlow branding from exported PDFs.

To review: select a language in Settings > App Language, create a project, add a calculation, and open Quote Preview. Change the App Language setting and reopen the quote preview or a saved version to verify localized PDF labels and built-in materials. Customer-entered content and financial data are preserved. No account is required. Core calculations work offline. SteelFlow Pro is a non-consumable lifetime purchase (com.steelflow.app.pro.lifetime), not a subscription. Project data stays on the device; RevenueCat processes anonymous purchase and entitlement information.

pricing.note: Use territory-specific App Store price points; do not auto-convert from one base currency.
